title: Mega Man 10
intro: A route through the Robot Masters, the utility items worth collecting, and the final stages. Read the introduction for the controls and systems specific to this game.
facts: Weapons, utility items and final stages
primer: Mega Man has no slide or charged Buster. Proto Man has both, with a shield and increased damage taken. Bass has rapid fire, directional aim and a dash, but cannot shoot while running. Choose a campaign before starting.
E-Tanks are one-use full-health refills. Open the weapon menu before the next hit could kill you. They are not refillable Sub Tanks.

Rush Coil is available immediately; Rush Jet follows four Robot Master clears in Mega Man’s campaign. There are no hidden armor or Heart Tanks. Easy mode changes hazards and boss patterns; the route below assumes Normal.
routeIntro: Pump is a reasonable Buster start and avoids relying on awkward Thunder Wool timing. Follow Water Shield through the loop, ending at Sheep.

returnIntro: Collect the listed utility items before entering the fortress. Ordinary energy, lives and tanks are consumable supplies, not X-style permanent health upgrades.
completionText: Clear all Robot Masters, check the utility items listed above, and refill the weapons needed for the final stages.

sections.title: Shop, supplies and character choices
paragraphs: Energy Balancer and E-Tanks are useful purchases. Bass’s shop also supplies Treble Boost, which gives flight at the cost of weapon energy.
Special stages Enker, Punk and Ballade are separate extras. Mega Man earns Mirror Buster, Screw Crusher and Ballade Cracker by clearing them; they are not required for the normal ending.

sections.title: Wily’s fortress
paragraphs: Weapons Archive: use Wheel Cutter for Elec and Gemini, Triple Blade for Wood, Solar Blaze for Ring, Rebound Striker for Napalm, Water Shield for Flame, Commando Bomb for Frost, Chill Spike for Slash, and Thunder Wool’s lightning for Tornado.
Crab Puncher: hit the eyes and use Commando Bomb’s explosion while the claws are open. Block Devil: learn the block sequence, then strike the open eye with Thunder Wool’s lightning or Buster.
Wily Machine: ride the missiles to reach the target and use Solar Blaze. Capsule: use Water Shield during a safe appearance; continue dodging when Wily disappears. Keep a tank for the final fight.

sections.title: Useful tips
paragraphs: Chill Spike’s ground spikes do the important damage against Nitro. Commando Bomb’s explosion does more damage than a direct hit against Blade.
Wheel Cutter climbs walls while held against them. It can save a difficult ladder or wall approach without using a glitch.
